SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN prc_usd IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) usd_null,
  SUM(CASE WHEN prc IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) prc_null,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(prc_usd - prc/100.0) < 0.001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) equal_rows,
  SUM(CASE WHEN prc_usd IS NOT NULL AND ABS(prc_usd - prc/100.0) >= 0.001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) diff_rows
FROM items_g2;

SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(prc)/100.0, 4) AS avg_listed_usd_from_cents,
  ROUND(AVG(prc_usd), 4)   AS avg_clipped_usd_col,
  COUNT(prc) AS n_with_price,
  COUNT(prc_usd) AS n_usd_col
FROM items_g2 WHERE prc IS NOT NULL;
